_comment: Blender export -> Unreal import manifest. fbx paths are relative to Art/Export. Run: python Tools/ue_exec.py Tools/ue_scripts/import_assets.py [AssetName ...]

SM_OceanTile32._note: xy in cells (instance scale = cell size), z in cm. Must cover the largest wave displacement: horizontal swells + wind sea ~10 m (= 40 LOD0 cells), vertical ~8-9 m at Storm (D30).

SM_OceanTile16._note: xy in cells (instance scale = cell size), z in cm. Must cover the largest wave displacement: horizontal swells + wind sea ~10 m (= 40 LOD0 cells), vertical ~8-9 m at Storm (D30).

SM_Seabed._note: Collision floor of the visual test cove (build_seabed.py, the broad shape at 1 m cells); hidden in the map, the visible sand is SM_Seabed_Sand. Not Nanite: complex collision.

SM_Seabed_Sand._note: Visible sand of the visual test cove (D37): 0.2 m cells with sculpted ripples and vertex colours (crest, trough, tone). No collision (SM_Seabed collides).

SM_Boat_Hull._note: Hand-made starter boat (D36, D38): planked hull, deck, bulwarks, rig. Hull shape mirrors Source/Saltbound/Boat/SaltHullShape.h; ASaltBoat moves the other parts.
